nodes.text: Create a sunlit New York brownstone block around two narrow asphalt streets meeting at a right angle. Line the sidewalks with roughly fifteen tightly spaced three- to five-story row houses and apartment buildings, using weathered red brick, brownstone, and pale stone with varied heights and setbacks. Add sash windows, cornices, fire escapes, window air conditioners, basement openings, and raised stoops with iron railings. Place mature street trees, small front plantings, benches, and American flags. Mark roads with crossings, dashed lines, manholes, and fallen leaves. Add curved lamps, mailboxes, hydrants, bins, signs, a yellow taxi, a van, and a dark sedan under bright midday light.
